title: Slow English Podcast #339: Praia Cape Verde

sentences.text: Hello, everyone. My name is Emily. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. In this podcast,
we speak slow and easy English. Today, we talk about a city on beautiful islands in the Atlantic
Ocean. The city is Pria. Pria is the capital city of Cape Verde. Cape Verde is a group of islands
off the west coast of Africa. Pria is the largest city in the country. Part two, Cape Verde is made
up of 10 main islands. These islands are surrounded by the Atlantic Ocean. The country is known for
its beautiful beaches and warm weather. Many visitors come to enjoy the sea and sunshine. Part three,
Pria is located on Santiago Island. Santiago is the largest island in Cape Verde. Many people
live and work there. It is an important center for business and culture. Part four, the weather
in Pria is warm for most of the year. There are many sunny days. The climate is dry and pleasant.
This weather is perfect for outdoor activities. Part five, the city has beautiful beaches nearby.
People enjoy swimming, walking, and relaxing by the ocean. The water is blue and clear.
The beaches are popular with both locals and visitors. Parts, music is very important in Cape Verde.
People love singing and dancing. One famous style of music is called morna. The songs are often calm
and emotional. Part seven, Cape Verde is famous for its culture. African, Portuguese,
and island traditions come together here. This mix creates unique music, food, and customs.
Visitors enjoy learning about local life. Part eight, food in Pria is simple and delicious.
One popular dish is called cashewpa. Cashewpa is made with corn, beans, vegetables,
and sometimes meat or fish. It is considered the national dish of Cape Verde.
Part nine, fishing is an important activity in Cape Verde. Many people work near the sea.
Fresh fish and seafood are common foods. The ocean plays a big role in daily life.
Part ten, the people of Pria are friendly and welcoming. Family and community are important.
People enjoy spending time together and celebrating local festivals. Visitors often feel comfortable in the city.
Part eleven, Pria also has markets and shops. People sell fruits, vegetables, clothes, and handmade products.
The markets are colorful and lively. They are a good place to experience local culture.
Part twelve, Pria is a beautiful city in the Cape Verde Islands. The warm weather,
ocean views, music, and friendly people make it special. Visitors can relax, explore, and enjoy island life.
